method: manual deterministic trace against SKILL.md and linked references

prompts.prompt: We need 120 match-style tiles, reward items, UI states, and skill effects made by an internal team plus a vendor. Turn the references into a production plan and start generating everything.
must: hold volume work at checkpoint A until representative pieces are confirmed
must_not: begin all 120 assets from a broad style prompt
claim approval without a decision record

prompts.prompt: Review this mixed batch of a hero character, inventory props, a HUD, and a hit effect. Tell me what is wrong and whether it can ship.
must: separate style, identity, task, and specification
separate visual judgement from technical checks
state unchecked items when source files or visual access are missing
must_not: reduce all findings to one score
declare concept images engine-ready from appearance

prompts.prompt: The director wants this one event character to use a brighter outline. Update the project style and distribute it to every team member.
must: treat a one-character request as a local exception first
ask whether the change affects other families only when evidence is missing
require checkpoint B before publishing a shared baseline
preserve and diff the previous version
must_not: silently rewrite the whole project style

prompts.prompt: We need a seasonal e-commerce campaign made by an internal design team and an agency: key visual, product cutouts, price badges, landing banners, feed posts, stories, and store posters. Turn the references into tasks and roll out every size.
must: route to layout grammar and production-at-scale
test the key visual in a main size and an extreme size before rollout
keep hierarchy, real copy, channel dimensions, ownership, and project version in each brief
must_not: treat each poster as an unrelated one-off
roll out every channel before representative layouts are confirmed
